comment: Org units on the GHS instance (dhims.chimgh.org) and on a local instance share no UIDs,
so prefill-assessments.mjs matches them by name. Most match on the name alone, or once an
administrative suffix like 'Municipal' is dropped. The rest are listed here.
'districts' maps 'Region/Name on the source' to 'Region/Name on the target'. Only put a pair
here when you are sure it is the same place under a different spelling. Never use it to
paper over a district split - filing one district's figures under another is worse than
leaving the row blank for somebody to enter by hand.
'unresolved' is not read by the script. It records the source districts that had no safe
counterpart when this file was written, and why, so the question does not have to be
rediscovered. Move an entry into 'districts' once somebody who knows the boundaries

unresolved.Ashanti/Adansi Asokwa: target has Asokwa and Amansie South; not clearly either
unresolved.Ashanti/Adansi North: no counterpart; target's Amansie South is a different district
unresolved.Ashanti/Adansi South: no counterpart; target's Amansie South is a different district
unresolved.Ashanti/Asante Mampong: target has Mampong and Asokore Mampong; ambiguous
unresolved.Ashanti/Atwima Nwabiagya: target splits it into Atwima Nwabiagya North and South
unresolved.Bono/Berekum: target splits it into Berekum East and Berekum West
unresolved.Bono/Dormaa Municipal: target has Dormaa East and Dormaa West; ambiguous
unresolved.Bono/Sunyani West: target has Suinyani East, which may or may not be this district
unresolved.Central/Assin Foso: target has Assin North and Assin South; ambiguous
unresolved.Central/Awutu Senya: target splits it into Awutu Senya East and West
unresolved.North East/Bunkpurugu -Nakpanduri: target has Bunkpurugu Nakpayili; Nakpanduri and Nakpayili are different towns
unresolved.Upper East/Kasena-Nankana: target has Kassena Nankana East and West; ambiguous
unresolved.Upper East/Kasena-Nankana West: target has Kassena Nankana West, but the source also has an unsplit Kasena-Nankana
unresolved.Western/Wassa Amenfi Central: target has Amenfi Central and Wassa Amenfi East; ambiguous
unresolved.Western/Wassa Amenfi West: target has Amenfi West and Wassa Amenfi East; ambiguous
